Miner finds large diamond in Madhya Pradesh, second find for family

A miner in the Panna district of Madhya Pradesh has discovered an 11.19-carat diamond. This marks the second significant diamond find for the same tribal family within two years, with previous discoveries reportedly valued at higher amounts. The latest diamond is estimated to be worth between 30 to 50 lakh rupees, depending on its quality and market demand.
